This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with crime No.150/2024 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Lasudiya, Dist. Indore for offences punishable under Sections 354, 506, 376 of IPC.
2. As per the prosecution case, initially she was working in the school of the present applicant up to 2012 and thereafter she started working in some other school.
Thereafter it is alleged that the applicant started threatening and also creating dispute with her children.
She also made a complaint against him in the year 2018.
After the dispute of the accused with her husband she started living alone with the children at Indore from 2018.
It is alleged that she got divorced from her husband.
It is alleged that on phone, he used to talk obscenely.
He used to chase her with bad intention.
When she was going along with her friend namely, Girish to lodge the report, she was threatened.

sentences.text: In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. prosecutrix did not make any allegation regarding the rape.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. first time she made allegation that the applicant had committed rape with her on threat to kill her.
It is further submitted that the prosecutrix is a major woman of 49 years old and the applicant has been falsely implicated.
3. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she has made allegation regarding rape.

4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the entire facts of the case and the fact that in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she did not make any allegation regarding rape,
first time the allegation of rape has been made through the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., a notice under Section 41A Cr.P.C. was issued to the applicant and he had cooperated with the investigation, without commenting on the merits of the case, I find prima facie case is made out for grant of anticipatory bail.

5. It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant Sanjay Trivedi shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of arresting officer on the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation.
(ii) The applicant shall not approach the prosecutrix or witnesses.

(iii) The applicant shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
6.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
7. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.
Certified copy as per rules.
